summary: All 8 reorder-hole targets promoted to exact records, all high confidence. Block A (121-125) is the Itachi Pursuit / Sasuke-vs-Deidara stretch, chs 353-364: three episode-to-chapter tables (Narutopedia infoboxes via the MediaWiki API, animefillerguide, ListFist) agree verbatim on every row, and genuinely independent corroboration came from Wikipedia's chapter list and season-6 synopses — ep 121's Japanese title (動き出すものたち) is ch 354's exact title 'On the Move', ep 124 'Art' ends on ch 362 'The Ultimate Art!!' (Deidara's suicide blast), and ep 125's Zetsu-report/Manda-escape/Pain-reveal content is unmistakably 363-364. The one real interleave in block A is the 122/123 cut: both sources list 356-357 in BOTH episodes — the Kabuto collision (356 + early 357) is ep 122's bulk while the fight proper (357-359) is ep 123's, with the boundary panels shared across the cut — so ep 122 gets continue 357 and ep 123 starts 357 per majority rule with the 356 share stated. Block B (130-132) turns out to be a clean monotonic mainline run 370-379 (the interleaving in this zone was entirely the 127-128 flashback fragments, already recorded): 130 = 370-374 (title 'The Man Who Became God' mirrors ch 374 神への成長!! 'Growth into godhood'), 131 = 375-376 (mainline frame of 376; its prophecy panels went to ep 127), 132 = 377-379 ending on the six-Paths reveal that abuts ch 380 'Faces…!!' (already assigned to eps 133-134). Surprise worth noting: ep 131's title is ch 377's exact title (仙人モード) yet every source puts 377 in ep 132 — the anime shifts the title one episode early. No repairs.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 353-354 (Akatsuki learns of Orochimaru's death and mobilises Deidara/Tobi (353 'The Akatsuki Assembles…!!', opening on the Four-Tails/Rōshi capture); Kakashi's Eight Man Squad formed and both hunts set out (354))
anchors.note: All three tables agree 353-354; ep 121's Japanese title 動き出すものたち = ch 354's exact title (動き出す者たち 'On the Move') — independent Wikipedia title match. Resumes the mainline exactly at the Kakashi-Gaiden continue point 353.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 355 ('Where to…?!': the tracking sub-teams and Hebi's individual searches; Karin/Sakura near-miss), 356 ('Collision…!!': the Kabuto ambush and the Akatsuki intel handover), 357 (first part: Kabuto's Orochimaru-graft reveal and escape; Deidara finds Sasuke, the C1 bombs and the Sharingan stare-down)
anchors.note: All three tables agree 355-357. The 356-357 boundary panels are shared with ep 123 (both sources list both chapters in both episodes): 122 carries the Kabuto bulk, 123 the fight proper — hence continue 357, not 358.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 356 (tail share: the stare-down/confrontation-start panels re-covered from ep 122's ending), 357 ('Deidara vs. Sasuke!!': Tobi sliced through, C1 spiders and dolls), 358 ('Chasing C2!!': the C2 Clay Dragon, landmines, the dragon bisected), 359 ('Those Eyes…!!': Deidara pinned, his Itachi-coercion flashback and Sharingan hatred)
anchors.note: All three tables agree 356-359; start 357 per majority rule (the 356 share is a boundary tail, stated in the list). Synopsis content maps cleanly onto the chapter titles; ep 124 = 360-362 confirms 359 completes here.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 360 ('The C4 Karura': the microscopic-bomb gambit, Sasuke's apparent death), 361 ('Achilles' Heel…!!': the genjutsu reveal and Sasuke's counter through Deidara's blind spot), 362 ('The Ultimate Art!!': Deidara turns himself into a living bomb)
anchors.note: All three tables agree 360-362; ep title 'Art' (芸術) ends on ch 362 究極芸術!! 'The Ultimate Art!!' — independent Wikipedia title/content match (v40 is even named after this chapter).

anchors.chapters_adapted: 363 ('Sasuke's Death…!!': Zetsu's report, Akatsuki mourns, Itachi knows Sasuke lives; the Manda escape revealed), 364 ('The Target…!!': the Hebi safehouse, the Eight Man Squad picks up the scent, Pain and Konan meet Tobi — the Nine-Tails made the priority target)
anchors.note: All three tables agree 363-364; the synopsis (Manda sacrifice, Pain-as-leader reveal, Tobi's 'deal with the Nine-Tails' order) is unmistakably these two chapters. Ep 126 = 365-367 (stored) confirms the boundary — continue default 365.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 370 ('Unease': Naruto's premonition, the Jiraiya/Tsunade farewell, Gerotora and the Eight Trigrams key), 371 ('Old Acquaintances!!': Konan confronts her former sensei; mainline half — its Tobi-on-Sasuke fragment is reused in ep 134), 372-373 (present-day halves: Pain arrives, Nagato confirmed, the god ideology and the orphans exchange — their Ame-orphan flashback panels were already used in ep 128), 374 ('Advancement!!' 神への成長: Pain's tailed-beast plan; Gamaken summoned, the summons battle begins)
anchors.note: All three tables agree 370-374; ep title 神となった男 'The Man Who Became God' mirrors ch 374's kanji 神への成長!! ('growth into godhood') — independent semantic title match, and the Gerotora beat pins 370. Mainline continues clean from ep 129's 369.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 375 ('Two Great Sages…!!': the clasped-hands Sage-Mode preparation, Gamaken vs the multiplying dogs, the toad-stomach reverse summon, the drill-beaked bird — ending with Fukasaku and Shima summoned), 376 (mainline frame only: Sage Mode entered, the Rinnegan/child-of-prophecy discussion and the duty to kill Pain; 376's prophecy-flashback panels were already used in ep 127)
anchors.note: All three tables agree 375-376; the synopsis is wall-to-wall ch-375 content plus 376's present-day frame. NB the ep title 発動! 仙人モード matches ch 377's exact title (仙人モード!!) but every source places 377 in ep 132 — the anime runs the title one episode ahead of the chapter.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 377 ('Sage Mode!!': Preta and Human Paths summoned, the blinding kick, Sage Art: Goemon, the Rasengan absorbed), 378 ('One to One…!!': the shared-vision deduction, the one-ability-per-Path theory proven), 379 ('Jiraiya's Decision!!': the Toad Confrontation Chant, the three Paths impaled, the ambush that takes Jiraiya's arm, the six Paths of Pain revealed)
anchors.note: All three tables agree 377-379. The closing beat (Jiraiya recognising one of the Paths) abuts ch 380 'Faces…!!' (その面影), which the stored records assign to eps 133-134 — continue is the default 380.

flags_for_sean: Source-lineage caveat continues from batch 15: Narutopedia infoboxes, animefillerguide, and ListFist agree verbatim on all 10 rows checked (121-126, 130-133) — likely shared lineage. Every anchor therefore also cites an independent Wikipedia corroboration (exact kanji title match 121↔ch354; content/title matches 124↔ch362, 130↔ch374; season-6 synopses for 122, 125, 131, 132).

Ep 131's Japanese title (発動! 仙人モード) is ch 377's exact title (仙人モード!!), yet all sources put ch 377 in ep 132 — recorded as-is (131 = 375-376) since the ep-131 synopsis is entirely 375 + 376-frame content; noting it in case a title-match heuristic elsewhere in the pipeline would want to pull 377 into 131.

Ep 132's final seconds (Jiraiya recognising a Path) brush the opening of ch 380 'Faces…!!'; 380 is already assigned to eps 133-134 in stored records, so 132 is kept at 377-379 with default continue 380 — consistent with the stored ep-133 note ('narutopedia adds 380').
